title: Simulating Stress Laws under Extremal Dependence: Characterizing What Generative Models Must Preserve
abstract: arXiv:2608.13056v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study stress-scenario generation for systems driven by multivariate heavy-tailed risk factors. Within regions where several financial losses are simultaneously extreme, stress analysis concerns both the conditional law of the risk factors and the most plausible configurations producing those losses. We show that both are governed by the same limiting tail law. Preserving its measure recovers rare-event probabilities and scaled conditional stress laws, while misspecifying extremal dependence distorts some regular joint-stress probability. Its density governs reverse-stress optimization, whose maximizers identify the most plausible stress configurations. To exploit this common structure in finite samples, we develop SSGEN (Self-Similar Generative Estimation), which learns extremal dependence from intermediate exceedances and extrapolates to rarer levels using a Pareto radial component. translated_title: 极端依赖下的压力法则模拟：刻画生成模型必须保留的特征
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13056v1 公告类型：新 摘要：我们研究了由多元重尾风险因素驱动的系统压力情景生成问题。在多个金融损失同时处于极端的区域内，压力分析既涉及风险因素的条件分布，也涉及产生这些损失的最可能配置。我们证明这两者由相同的极限尾部分布控制。保持其度量可以恢复罕见事件概率和缩放后的条件压力法则，而错误设定极端依赖则会扭曲某些正则联合压力概率。其密度控制着逆压力优化，其最大化器识别出最可能的压力配置。为了在有限样本中利用这一共同结构，我们开发了SSGEN（自相似生成估计），它从中间超阈值中学习极端依赖，并使用帕累托径向分量外推到更罕见的水平。即使目标事件在样本中不存在，该方法也能有效工作。
tldr: 本文提出SSGEN方法，证明极端依赖下的压力情景生成必须保留极限尾部分布，才能准确恢复罕见事件概率和最可能压力配置。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SSGEN, demonstrating that stress-scenario generation under extremal dependence must preserve the limiting tail law to accurately recover rare-event probabilities and the most plausible stress configurations.
